messages:
Marta L: hey team, first week here. followed the observability onboarding but stuck on two things: Grafana shows "permission denied" for /d/inference/overview and Datadog log explorer returns 403. Sentry link says "no access". my SSO is marta.l@redwood.ai

onboard-bot: welcome @Marta L! please paste your email and which dashboards/projects you need. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. if urgent tag @Infra Observability. :wave:

Marta L: email above. need read access to grafana folder "inference" (view only), Datadog logs for inference-prod, and Sentry project inference-runtime-prod view.

Jon P: congrats and welcome! quick checks: 1) try incognito to rule out stale cookies, 2) confirm Okta groups include redwood-observability. i can kick a SCIM sync and add grafana-viewer if needed.

Marta L: incognito still gives permission denied. Okta shows me in redwood-observability and engineers.

Jon P: thanks. i'm triggering a manual SCIM provisioning sync and refreshing grafana ACL cache for marta.l@redwood.ai now.

Infra Observability: queued provisioning job for marta.l@redwood.ai. we'll apply grafana-viewer and datadog-log-read; Sentry invites require project owner approval, i'll look up owners and send invites.

Marta L: grafana still 403 on the dashboard URL after the sync. Datadog explorer still 403 as well.

Jon P: can you run this quick API check from your machine (replace token from vault) and paste the HTTP code?

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Marta L: returns 403. i used the token in vault under observability/workspace-token.

Infra Observability: weird, SCIM completed but the datadog role mapping didn't apply due to a recent identity schema change (role label mismatch). manually granting datadog-log-read to marta.l@redwood.ai now.

Network: FYI we saw a proxy header rewrite earlier that caused Grafana embed ACL checks to fail for some new users. i've reverted that rule for the web-app path; please retry @Marta L.

Marta L: reran curl  now returns 200. Grafana dashboard loads too. Sentry invite arrived and accepted. everything looks good now, thanks!

Marta L: quick follow-up: who owns the inference dashboards? i want to add p95/p99 lines and a short note about cold-start bias before proposing alert changes.

Infra Observability: dashboards live in repos/infra/monitoring/grafana-dashboards and are owned by infra-observability. small visual tweaks are fine via PR with exported JSON. alert or threshold changes need approval from infra-observability and SRE—post a short rationale in #observability-dashboards and tag us. if you want a short-term grafana-editor to prototype, request here and we'll grant for 24h.

Marta L: please grant editor for 8h so i can prototype. i'll open the PR and tag infra-observability + SRE before merging.

Jon P: granted grafana-editor to marta.l@redwood.ai for 8h. remember to export JSON and include test notes. welcome aboard! :tada:
